thread.title: Stocks mount late-day reversal, erasing Dow's 500 point decline

author: morningstar.com
title: Stocks mount late-day reversal, erasing Dow's 500 point decline
text:
U.S. stocks staged a late-day comeback Monday to push equity benchmarks into positive territory, as semiconductor shares drove the tech-heavy Nasdaq higher. The S&P 500 rose by 0.2% to end around 2,637, based on preliminary numbers. The Dow Jones Industrial Average advanced 33 points, or 0.1%, to around 24,422. The Nasdaq Composite rose 0.7% to around 7,021. But equities have struggled to notch a streak of positive sessions as softening global growth and simmering U.S.-China trade tensions have weighed on investor sentiment, even as economic data remains robust. In company news, Qualcomm shares (QCOM) rose after a Chinese court ordered Apple Inc. (AAPL) to stop selling older iPhone models in China for infringing two patents held by the chip manufacturer. Still, Apple shares ended slightly higher.
-Sunny Oh; 1602ET
